invalidity.problem: The V1 gate required a reduction of at least three final required-semantics failures, but the Ollama control had only two. It also failed to specify whether language pollution was measured before or after deterministic localization and sanitization.
invalidity.why_v1_cannot_select_a_model: At least one quality requirement is mathematically unreachable, so a candidate could not pass all preregistered gates even with zero semantic failures.
invalidity.preserved_value: The control run establishes the exact Ollama baseline and exposed a measurement-definition defect before any candidate output could influence the replacement gate.
